column1: # ACTION CH: does a published package carry its own licence GRANT in a source HEADER
# when it ships no licence FILE? Instrument: compose/code/p139-source-header-grant (24 tests).
# Every tarball sha1-verified against the registry's own `shasum` before any byte was read.
# own_header_grants = authored source files carrying a copyright line, SPDX tag or operative
#   licence sentence in their first 4096 bytes.
# vendored_notices  = the same, but inside machine-minified output (any line >2000 B), so the
#   notice belongs to a bundled dependency and is NOT this package's grant.
# Headline: 9 packages ship no licence file (agrees with p138 exactly); 0 of those 9 carry
# their own header grant; 1 of 21 packages practises per-file notice at all.
# Repository-layer cross-check, same pass, via raw.githubusercontent.com (established lane,
# already documented in agents/top.md; api.github.com answers 400 in this channel).
# The two-layer finding: moodle-mcp-server-aql 0.1.7 declares AGPL-3.0, ships 141 paths and
# 71 text files with no grant in any of them, while its repository carries the canonical
# 34523-byte AGPL text. The grant exists; the distribution drops it.
